description: Set up the feature-based project architecture (core, shared, features, layout), built the first reusable components — Header, SearchBar, ProductCard — and got parent-child communication working with input() and output().
Added routing with lazy loading, built the Shop, Cart, and Auth pages, and started using Angular Signals — signal(), computed(), and effect() — to manage state reactively across the app.
Replaced template inputs with Reactive Forms across Login, Register, and Profile, wrote a custom password validator, and learned ControlValueAccessor the hard way — by forgetting it once.
Coming soon — this sprint is still in progress. Check back for the update once it wraps up!
